# Fixtures

- `kokoro/`: real answers of Kokoro-FastAPI (`ghcr.io/remsky/kokoro-fastapi-cpu`,
  November 2026): clips of the `ff_siwis`, `af_heart` and `ef_dora` voices in
  the four formats Gladys plays, the model and voice lists, and three error
  bodies (the voice list of the unknown-voice error is shortened).
- `openai/`: answers of the OpenAI API written after its documentation, not
  recorded (no key was used): model list and two error bodies.
